skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the nature and philosophy of marketing
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the essence, ideology, and fundamental philosophies of marketing.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Recognizing the role and position of marketing
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the role and position of marketing and its relationship with other functional departments.
Understand the process of implementing marketing towards effective marketing decision-making.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Role of information in marketing decisions
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the role of information in marketing decisions and how to collect and analyze such information.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Strategic marketing decisions using STP formula
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature and method of making strategic marketing decisions through the STP formula.
Understand the nature and role of basic marketing tools with the 4Ps formula and analyze marketing activities at organizations.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Information gathering and general analysis of marketing activities
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Demonstrate the ability to gather information and generally analyze marketing activities at specific companies.
Begin to equip students with an understanding of the social context and professional ethics, social responsibility.
